statements.status_notes: Fixed in wasmtime 48.0.8. influxdb3-core on the 3.10 and 3.11 release lines links wasmtime 41.0.4 through git-sourced datafusion-udf-wasm-host. Updating the lockfile to wasmtime 48.x resolves dependencies but datafusion-udf-wasm-host does not compile against the wasmtime 48.x API on those lines. Waiting for upstream influxdb releases that adopt a fixed wasmtime ecosystem.

The fix requires upgrading wasmtime from 41.0.4 to at least 46.0.3, which crosses multiple Cargo major version boundaries. The upstream datafusion-udf-wasm-host dependency constrains wasmtime to ^41.0.1 (>=41.0.1, <42.0.0). Waiting for an upstream fix or backport that updates wasmtime without introducing incompatible dependency changes.
